questions.question: What is 'SearchFilter' in DRF?

options.A: A tool to search for bugs
options.B: A filter backend that supports simple search-filter styling based on a single query parameter
options.C: A way to filter the database admin

questions.question: What is 'OrderingFilter' in DRF?

options.B: A filter backend that allows clients to control the ordering of the results with a query parameter
options.C: A way to sort the project files

questions.question: What is 'Throttling' Rate?

options.B: The maximum number of requests allowed per second, minute, or day
options.D: The number of lines of code

questions.question: What is 'Django Extensions' package?

options.B: A collection of custom extensions for the Django Framework (e.g., shell_plus, show_urls)

questions.question: What is 'shell_plus'?

options.A: A large shell from the beach
options.B: An enhanced Django shell that automatically imports all your project models

questions.question: What is 'Proxy Models'?

options.B: A way to change the Python behavior of a model (like default ordering) without changing the database schema

questions.question: What is 'Model Inheritance' Multi-table?

options.B: A type of inheritance where each model in the hierarchy has its own database table

questions.question: Final question: What is the primary benefit of the 'Batteries Included' philosophy of Django?

options.A: It comes with physical batteries for the server
options.B: It provides a vast range of built-in features (Auth, Admin, ORM) out of the box so you don't have to reinvent the wheel
options.C: It is faster than any other framework
